sources.title: litert-community/RF-DETR-Nano-LiteRT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RF-DETR is a transformer detector (windowed DINOv2-S backbone + deformable-attention DETR decoder). Off-the-shelf it is GPU-incompatible (deformable grid_sample → GATHER_ND, windowed attention → 5D/6D tensors, two-stage query selection → TOPK / GATHER).

sources.snippet: RF-DETR is a transformer detector (DINOv2 backbone + deformable-attention DETR decoder) — a model family that previously did not ride the GPU API cleanly (deformable grid_sample → GATHER_ND, windowed attention → 5D/6D tensors, two-stage query selection → TOPK / GATHER).
